---
title: "Signed event attestation"
---

::: {.status-box .status-complete}
**Status: Documented and demonstrated**

This status is based on the supplied project documentation and example XLSForms. It is not a formal validation claim.

Biometric/Pin/Pattern attestation are fully implemented

NFC credential provisioning and verification are handled in the NFC capabilities

Password, QR and anchor bundle are not fully implemented
:::

## Purpose

Create signed evidence that an event payload was attested using a selected local verification dependency, and anchor bundles of attestations.

## Capability IDs

- `attestation.create`
- `attestation.anchor_bundle`

## Requirements

- Configured MethodMesh device key.
- Verification dependency required by the selected method.

## Supported XLSForm calls

**From `example_odk_attestation.create_Fingerprint.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='attestation.create',entity_type='participant',entity_id=${participant_id},subject_id=${participant_id},operator_id=${operator_id_input},input_study_id='methodmesh_attestation_test',input_event_type='form_submission',input_event_payload_hash=${event_payload_hash},input_verification_method='Fingerprint',input_trusted_timestamp=${timestamp_policy},return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_attestation.create_Pin.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='attestation.create',entity_type='participant',entity_id=${participant_id},subject_id=${participant_id},operator_id=${operator_id_input},input_study_id='methodmesh_attestation_test',input_event_type='form_submission',input_event_payload_hash=${event_payload_hash},input_verification_method='Pin',input_trusted_timestamp=${timestamp_policy},return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_attestation.create_Password.xlsx`:**

``` text

```

**From `example_odk_attestation.create_Qr.xlsx`:**

**From `methodmesh_fingerprint_attestation_test.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='attestation.create',event_payload_hash=${event_payload},verification_method='Fingerprint',trusted_timestamp=${timestamp_policy},return_mode='flat')
```

## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Field | Label | XLSForm type |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| start |  | start |
| end |  | end |
| odk_device_id |  | deviceid |
| odk_username |  | username |
| participant_id | Participant ID | text |
| operator_id_input | Operator ID | text |
| timestamp_policy | Trusted timestamp policy | select_one timestamp_policy |
| event_description | Data or event being attested | text |
| verification_evidence_input | Study verification token (returned as attestation evidence) | text |
| study_id_input | Study ID | text |
